_comment: dbpedia-entities-openai-1M (1536d cosine). Anchored on (recall, build_speed) for high-dim: head_ratio=0.30 — high-dim SPANN is more sensitive to head quality, 300k centroids covers the 1M base well. posting_page_limit=24 (vs 16 for 96d) because at 1536d each vector occupies ~6 KB, a 12-page (48 KB) posting only holds ~8 vectors. internal_result_num=128 / max_check=16384 widen search candidates. num_threads/io_threads=32 caps build wall-clock.
